groups.passage:
To: All Staff, Harlow Print Solutions
From: Denise Okafor, Facilities Manager
Date: 14 March
Subject: Parking lot resurfacing

Please be advised that the north parking lot will be closed from Monday, 24 March, through Friday, 28 March, while contractors resurface the pavement and repaint the lines. During this period, employees may use the overflow lot on Carver Street, which is a five-minute walk from the main entrance. A shuttle van will run between the two locations every fifteen minutes from 7:00 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. and from 4:30 P.M. to 6:30 P.M.

Visitors and delivery drivers will still be able to use the six spaces beside the loading dock. Staff members with a disability permit should contact the reception desk, as a limited number of spaces near the south entrance will be reserved for them.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while this work is carried out.

Denise Okafor

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To inform staff of a temporary closure
To request volunteers for a project
To introduce a new shuttle company
questions.explain: Email báo bãi đỗ xe phía bắc đóng cửa từ 24 đến 28/3 để trải lại mặt đường ("will be closed from Monday, 24 March, through Friday, 28 March").

questions.prompt: According to the email, who should contact the reception desk?
choices: Staff members holding a disability permit
questions.explain: Email viết "Staff members with a disability permit should contact the reception desk" — nhân viên có thẻ khuyết tật cần liên hệ quầy lễ tân.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned about the shuttle van?
questions.explain: Email nêu xe chạy 15 phút một chuyến, buổi sáng 7:00–9:30 và chiều tối 4:30–6:30, nhưng không hề nói xe miễn phí.

groups.passage:
Brightwater Library Unveils Renovated Learning Wing

SALEM HEIGHTS (2 May) — After eighteen months of construction, the Brightwater Public Library reopened its east wing on Saturday with a ribbon-cutting ceremony attended by more than three hundred residents. [1] The renovated space includes twelve bookable study rooms, a recording studio for podcasters, and a makerspace equipped with 3D printers and sewing machines.

Library director Paulo Ferreira said the project was shaped by a community survey conducted in 2023. “People told us they needed quiet places to work and tools they could not afford at home,” he explained. [2] The $4.2 million renovation was funded largely by a regional grant, with the remainder coming from private donations.

Study rooms can be reserved up to one week in advance through the library's Web site. [3] Use of the makerspace requires completion of a free one-hour safety orientation, offered every Tuesday and Thursday evening. [4] Ferreira added that the library plans to extend its weekend opening hours starting in July.

questions.prompt:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“Each reservation is limited to three hours per day.”
questions.explain: Câu nói về giới hạn mỗi lượt đặt chỗ nên phải đứng ngay sau câu "Study rooms can be reserved up to one week in advance", tức vị trí [3].

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the renovation project?
choices: It was influenced by residents' feedback.
It was completed ahead of schedule.
It was paid for entirely by donations.
It added a café to the library.
questions.explain: Giám đốc thư viện nói dự án được định hình bởi một cuộc khảo sát cộng đồng ("shaped by a community survey"). Kinh phí chủ yếu từ tài trợ vùng, không phải toàn bộ từ quyên góp.

questions.prompt: What must patrons do before using the makerspace?
choices: Reserve it online a week ahead
questions.explain: Bài viết nói dùng makerspace phải hoàn thành buổi hướng dẫn an toàn một tiếng miễn phí ("requires completion of a free one-hour safety orientation").

groups.passage:
Marisol Vega [9:12 A.M.]: Hi Tom, I'm at the Lindell Hotel for the client workshop. The projector in Room B isn't connecting to my laptop.
Tom Achebe [9:14 A.M.]: Did you try the HDMI adapter in the gray case?
Marisol Vega [9:15 A.M.]: That's the one I'm using. The screen just says “no signal.”
Tom Achebe [9:17 A.M.]: The hotel has a technician on call. Ask the front desk to send someone up.
Marisol Vega [9:18 A.M.]: The workshop starts at 9:30.
Tom Achebe [9:19 A.M.]: Then email me the slides. I'm still in the lobby, so I can print twenty copies at the business center and bring them up. That way you can start on time either way.
Marisol Vega [9:20 A.M.]: Perfect. Sending them now.

questions.prompt: At 9:18 A.M., what does Ms. Vega most likely mean when she writes, “The workshop starts at 9:30”?
choices: She wants to reschedule the workshop.
She is worried there is not enough time to wait for help.
She thinks Mr. Achebe has the wrong time.
questions.explain: Ngay sau khi Tom đề nghị gọi kỹ thuật viên, cô nhắc buổi workshop bắt đầu lúc 9:30, ý là có thể không kịp chờ; Tom liền đưa giải pháp in tài liệu để "start on time".

questions.prompt: What will Mr. Achebe most likely do next?
questions.explain: Tom nói sẽ in hai mươi bản slide ở business center ("print twenty copies") và Marisol đồng ý gửi slide ngay.

groups.passage:
Kestrel Cycle Works — Spring Tune-Up Special

Is your bicycle ready for the season? Throughout April, Kestrel Cycle Works is offering a complete tune-up for just $45, down from our regular price of $70. The service includes brake and gear adjustment, chain cleaning and lubrication, tire inflation, and a full safety inspection. Most tune-ups are finished within 24 hours.

Customers who book online at kestrelcycle.com will also receive a free water bottle. Electric bicycles are welcome, although battery diagnostics are charged separately at $20.

Visit us at 88 Orchard Lane. We are open Tuesday to Sunday, 9 A.M. to 6 P.M., and closed on Mondays.

questions.prompt: How much does the tune-up normally cost?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo ghi giá khuyến mãi $45 "down from our regular price of $70" — giá thường là $70.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about owners of electric bicycles?
choices: They may pay an additional fee.
They must visit on a Monday.
questions.explain: Xe đạp điện vẫn được nhận nhưng kiểm tra pin tính riêng $20 ("battery diagnostics are charged separately at $20"), nên có thể phải trả thêm.

groups.passage:
Text 1: Invoice
Greenleaf Office Furnishings
Invoice No. 50213 — Date: 3 June
Bill to: Ravenscroft Legal Partners, 41 Dunmore Street

Item | Qty | Unit price | Total
Ergonomic desk chair (model EC-20) | 8 | $210 | $1,680
Standing desk, oak finish | 4 | $450 | $1,800
Filing cabinet, three drawers | 2 | $180 | $360
Delivery and assembly | 1 | $150 | $150
Amount due: $3,990

Payment is due within 30 days. Questions about this invoice should be sent to billing@greenleafof.com.
-----
Text 2: Email
To: billing@greenleafof.com
From: Hyun-woo Park, Office Administrator, Ravenscroft Legal Partners
Date: 6 June
Subject: Invoice No. 50213

Hello,
Thank you for the prompt delivery on 4 June. However, I believe there is an error on the invoice we received. Our order was for six desk chairs, not eight, and only six were delivered. In addition, your sales representative, Ms. Lindqvist, agreed that delivery and assembly would be provided at no charge because our order exceeded $3,000.

Could you please send a corrected invoice? Once I receive it, I will arrange payment immediately.

Best regards,
Hyun-woo Park

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To complain about a late delivery
To ask about a chair model
questions.explain: Ông Park chỉ ra lỗi trên hóa đơn và đề nghị "send a corrected invoice". Hàng giao nhanh ("prompt delivery") nên không phải phàn nàn giao trễ.

questions.prompt: How many standing desks did Ravenscroft Legal Partners order?
questions.explain: Hóa đơn ghi "Standing desk, oak finish | 4", và email chỉ khiếu nại số ghế, không nói gì về bàn đứng.

questions.prompt: By how much does Mr. Park believe the amount due should be reduced?
questions.explain: Hai ghế bị tính thừa (8 thay vì 6) × $210 = $420, cộng phí giao hàng và lắp đặt $150 đáng lẽ miễn phí: tổng $570.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Ms. Lindqvist?
choices: She offered free delivery for orders above a certain amount.
She works in the billing department.
She sent the invoice on 3 June.
questions.explain: Bà Lindqvist là nhân viên bán hàng, đã đồng ý giao và lắp miễn phí "because our order exceeded $3,000".

questions.prompt: The word “prompt” in paragraph 1 of the email is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "Thank you for the prompt delivery" — cảm ơn vì giao hàng nhanh chóng; "prompt" ở đây nghĩa là quick.

groups.passage:
Text 1: Web page
Cedar Point Conference Center — Meeting Rooms

Willow Room: seats 20, built-in screen, $300 per day
Birch Room: seats 45, projector and sound system, $550 per day
Maple Hall: seats 120, stage, two projectors, $1,100 per day
Lakeview Terrace: seats 60, outdoor covered space, no audiovisual equipment, $700 per day

All bookings include free Wi-Fi and bottled water. Catering is available from our on-site kitchen; lunch packages start at $18 per person. Reservations made at least 60 days in advance receive a 10% discount.
-----
Text 2: Email
To: events@cedarpointcc.com
From: Amara Nwosu, Tellis Biotech
Date: 12 August
Subject: Booking request

I would like to reserve a room for our regional sales training on 9 October. We expect about 40 participants, and we will need a projector for presentations throughout the day. Because the weather in October can be unpredictable, we would prefer an indoor room. Please also include lunch for all attendees. Kindly confirm availability and the total cost.
-----
Text 3: Online review
Reviewed by Amara Nwosu, 15 October

Our training day at Cedar Point went smoothly overall. The room comfortably fit our group, and the sound system made it easy for everyone at the back to hear the speakers. The lunch was generous, although several vegetarian participants felt their options were limited. My only real disappointment was the cost: I had hoped to receive the early-booking discount, but I missed the deadline by just two days. Next year I will plan further ahead. I would still recommend the center to other companies.

questions.prompt: Which room did Tellis Biotech most likely use?
questions.explain: Nhóm khoảng 40 người, cần máy chiếu, phòng trong nhà (email); bài đánh giá khen hệ thống âm thanh. Chỉ Birch Room (45 chỗ, có máy chiếu và "sound system") khớp tất cả.

questions.prompt: What does the Web page indicate about all bookings?
choices: They are limited to one day.
questions.explain: Trang web ghi "All bookings include free Wi-Fi and bottled water". Bữa trưa phải đặt thêm (từ $18/người).

questions.prompt: Why did Tellis Biotech most likely not receive a discount?
choices: The booking was made fewer than 60 days in advance.
The event was held on a weekend.
questions.explain: Giảm 10% chỉ áp dụng khi đặt trước ít nhất 60 ngày; email gửi ngày 12/8 cho sự kiện 9/10 (58 ngày), và bà Nwosu thừa nhận "missed the deadline by just two days".

questions.prompt: What complaint does Ms. Nwosu make about the lunch?
choices: It offered few choices for vegetarians.
It cost too much per person.
questions.explain: Bài đánh giá viết "several vegetarian participants felt their options were limited" — ít lựa chọn cho người ăn chay; còn lượng thức ăn thì "generous".

questions.prompt: In the review, the word “generous” in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "The lunch was generous" nói về bữa trưa nên "generous" mang nghĩa nhiều, dồi dào (plentiful), không phải "tốt bụng".
